# Cutt.ly

Cutt.ly is a URL shortening service that allows users to shorten, manage, and analyze URLs.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/cutt-ly/.

## Actions

- **View Last Shortened URLs** (read-only): This action retrieves a list of recently shortened urls from your cutt.ly account.
